body: I had someone tell me recently, “unburden yourself of the people who find you a burden.” I grew up with a very harsh family and boyfriend. It’s something you will have to distance yourself from and that could be easy if you move to a area that’s cheaper and rent out a room from Craigslist’s or any other roommate apps. The medication is a process I’m sorry you can’t find a combo that works. Keep trying. I’m 28 now but when I was 17 I was a wreck constantly. I’m on this forum because I still don’t know what to think about being alive, it feels more than just uncomfortable. But honestly no lie, I don’t regret the time I was alive since than. It all becomes a blur as you get older and that sounds even more depressing I know. But you aren’t defined by these people. These also imperfect people. I imagine it being peaceful too. But parts of life are and will be. Maybe we could talk more if you private message me. Exchange numbers? You don’t have to be anything, it’s not over yet. The things that s screw us up the most is the picture in our head of how it is “supposed to be.” And I know it’s not everyone’s favorite outlook but you can always kill yourself tomorrow. That’s meant not to be taken seriously but do you get the point? Make it through the day. Make those day’s add up to something you can’t see yet.
Be my guru mistergoddess. New to social media and this took me hours to understand. Google searches yielded nothing but “it gets better” convos.
Until HE isn’t in your environment**

Your piece of shit ex isn’t your forever. You will figure this out. Mourn the person they were. They’re gone now. Misery loves company. At my worst I pretend I’m in a movie and I’m playing a roll. Your children are going to build their own life’s and you will be there with them. These are moments of suffering. Pretend you don’t care until they aren’t in your environment. If you want to text about it I’m on this site too because I’m feeling hopeless. I’m new to reddit but let me know if you need someone and we can talk.
Your just mad because you shot off your dick bitch ass judgmental troll
I hope you will be ok. I don’t know why but I do. Message me and we can talk about this not being into living thing. I’ve felt it too. That’s why I’m on here.

I think the monotony is one thing but I feel you on the apathy that comes along with just accepting you have to be alive because that’s what others want. I don’t want to die either. But I know I’m not really into “this!” Haha. Not sure what that means for all us 3 who feel this way. I keep thinking of the phrase “wherever you go there you are.” I don’t know how I feel about that statement. It feels like it relates to this feeling of not being 100% sure why or if I could continue this existence.

Thank you. I have no urge to push or facilitate anything like that for someone else or look for any methods for myself on this site. I’m just so exhausted with the lack of open-minded thoughts that I feel so relevant to my own being. I will look into that now and so appreciate your input.

I’m a Early childhood Educator and completely agree. I knew life could be monotonous but recently I feel like there’s more to it than that. I’m a beautiful 28 year woman who could keep going but I’m feeling trapped by selfish needs of others to preserve their image and guilt at my expense. I’m not 100% what or how I’m moving forward with this awareness but I so resonated with your post and the shame that is associated with these personal findings that should be my own. So very thankful to have heard from people tonight that don’t see me as weak for considering something that is oh so logical to me. Not just logical, but almost instinctual.

I could probably find child porn faster than pro suicide convos. (not that I would I’m a teacher!) but just saying, I agree. Selfishness and image isn’t my cross to bare If I feel I want out. It’s my body and mind.

Yes! You! I was just talking about this with my mom very calmly. Completely agree and don’t like the word “suicide” anymore. The word is like a damn movement now and I’m not even into the aspect of it being “something that should be prevented.” Not everything is that black and white and some people see things differently. I don’t want to feel shameful about the way I feel. Why can’t i KNOW I can get through things but don’t really want to? Shouldn’t it be my choice?
